storage.newIdRule: first missing non-negative integer, or maximum id plus one when there is no gap
storage.linkRule: append one linkedApps record and set the selected layer linkedAppId to the new id
storage.unlinkRule: remove the linkedApps record and remove the selected layer linkedAppId
storage.renameRule: editing the label changes only linkedApps name
storage.layerDeleteRule: remove only the selected profiles[].layers entry; an unreferenced linkedApps record is retained
storage.profileDeleteRule: remove only the selected profiles entry; unreferenced linkedApps records are retained
storage.duplicateLayerRule: create the copied layer without linkedAppId
storage.minimumIdentity: process or path must be a non-empty string

runtime.authority: Input focus service and device firmware
runtime.macPathBehavior: focus payload omits path and the linkedApps record stores an empty path string
runtime.matchRule: device firmware consumes the focus payload; the matching algorithm is not implemented in the Input renderer or main process

runtimeRead.layerIndex: device.status.selectedLayerIndex is firmware one-based; Input renderer subtracts one
